metadata.name: UpdateDemographic
metadata.description: This API is used to update the cardholder information Under account information as mentioned in the API request tags.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: This tag reflect the card number Valid Values:0-9 Example:1236547896541236 Condition:At least one of CardNumber/AdminNumber/AccountID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: HomePhoneNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder's Home Phone number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:7895463241 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Card Holder's address line 1. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:123 HWY Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. //Fixed TD 238735 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Card holder's address line 2. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:Park Avenue Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: City

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: This tag reflects the Country code. Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: State of the card holder address. Example:Virginia Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: LastName

request_fields.description: Title of the card holder. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Title Values Example: Mr Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.description: Card holder's Work phone number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:5678909876 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: MobilePhoneNumber

request_fields.name: EmailID
request_fields.description: Card holder's Email ID. Format: [email protected] Example: [email protected] Condition: Email id is not mandatory but user can not set it blank if it is having some value in Core. But user can update with new.Email ID can not be duplicate between card holder’s. Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 256

request_fields.name: MobileCarrier
request_fields.description: Carrier of Mobile Phone number. Valid Values:a-z,0-9 Example: BSNL Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SSN
request_fields.description: Card holder's Social Security Number. Format:AAAGGSSSS Example::078051120 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: GovernmentID
request_fields.description: Card holder's Government ID. Valid Values:A-Z Example:CDDT9741Q Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: IDNumber
request_fields.description: Card holder's Government ID Number. Format:AAAGGSSSS Example:078051120 Condition:This field is mandatory when government id type other than Other ID is used for cardholder identification. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: IDCountry
request_fields.description: Country of Identification proof. Valid Values:a-z, 0-9 Example: Canada Condition:This field is mandatory when government id Type other than Other ID is used for cardholder identification.Two character country code should be passed in the request and not country name. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: IDState
request_fields.description: Government identification issued state. Condition: GovernmentID issue state is mandatory, when Government id type is 'Drivers license' Or 'State ID' and ID issue country is US. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IDIssueDate
request_fields.description: Issue date of ID card. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02/01/2020 Condition: GovernmentID issue date is mandatory when governmentID type is 'Drivers license' and ID issue country is US and Id issue state is other than Massachusetts, Michigan, Missouri, Texas.

request_fields.name: IDExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Government issued identification expiration date. Valid Values: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 02012020 Condition: This field is mandatory when government id type other than Other ID is used for cardholder identification.

request_fields.name: BankruptcyNotificationDate
request_fields.description: Date when bankruptcy is notified. Format: MM/dd/YYYY Example: 07/25/1991 Condition: Mandatory for bankruptcy account
